name: Saukrates
description: '''Karl Amani Wailoo''' (born March 6, 1978), better known by his stage name '''Saukrates''' ({{IPAc-en|ˈ|s|ɒ|k|r|ə|t|iː|z}}; "[[Socrates]]"), is a Canadian [[rapping|rapper]], singer, and record producer. He is the co-founder of [[Capitol Hill Music]], and lead singer of the [[Contemporary R&B|R&B]] group [[Big Black Lincoln]]. He is also a member of [[Redman (rapper)|Redman]]'s Gilla House collective.
